items.title: The comparison map of a proper morphism is an isomorphism over the open locus where it is an isomorphism
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter duality.tex (Duality for Schemes)

items.difficulty_reason: Let f : X -> Y be a proper morphism of Noetherian schemes and let V in Y be an open such that f^{-1}(V) -> V is an isomorphism; the lemma asserts that for K in D_QCoh^+(O_Y) the comparison map (equation-compare-with-pullback) restricts to an isomorphism over f^{-1}(V) (statement lines 2170-2176). The proof first invokes Lemma labelled lemma-proper-noetherian to know that (equation-sheafy) is an isomorphism on D_QCoh^+(O_Y), then uses Lemma labelled lemma-restriction-compare-with-pullback to identify the restriction of the comparison map for K with the comparison map for K|_V and the morphism f^{-1}(V) -> V, so that it suffices to treat the case where f is an identity morphism, which is clear (proof lines 2178-2186). Reducing the assertion to the trivial identity case through the identification of the restricted comparison map is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
